Package org.apache.hadoop.io.erasurecode.rawcoder.util

Class GF256

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.io.erasurecode.rawcoder.util.GF256
@Private public final class GF256 extends Object
A GaloisField utility class only caring of 256 fields for efficiency. Some of the codes are borrowed from ISA-L implementation (C or ASM codes).
